'''Polis Massa''' was once an arid but habitable [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]; and the homeworld of the little-known [[Eellayin/Legends|Eellayin]] species. Polis Massa was later struck by a mysterious [[Polis Massa cataclysm/Legends|cataclysm]]. This natural disaster destroyed the planet and formed a [[Polis Massa Asteroid Field|field]] of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. The largest fragment of the planet remained known as Polis Massa and was colonized by the [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] who dedicated their entire species to excavate the remains of the now-vanished Eellayin civilization.

==Description==
[[File:PolisMassaNEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Polis Massa, prior to the cataclysm]]
Polis Massa was located in the fringes of the [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="db" /> It was once an arid<ref name="SWCL" /> desert planet<ref name="FF63" /> inhabited by the [[Eellayin/Legends|Eellayin]] civilization, which dwelt in underground cities such as [[Wiyentaah/Legends|Wiyentaah]].<ref name="db" />

After the mysterious [[Polis Massa cataclysm/Legends|cataclysm]] that totally destroyed the planet and annihilated the Eellayin, the largest fragment of the planet — a barren asteroid — remained known as Polis Massa. The [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] had colonized the [[Polis Massa Asteroid Field]], establishing research outposts on Polis Massa and other asteroids<ref name="Strongholds" /> under the leadership of the [[Archaeological Research Council/Legends|Archaeological Research Council]].<ref name="SWCL" /> The [[Polis Massa Research Base]] in the [[Wiyentaah crater]]<ref name="Strongholds" /> was the most important Polis Massan facility and served ''de facto'' as planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> Though the aliens frequented the Subterrel Sector,<ref name="RotS:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> they had little contact with [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and as a whole, the Polis Massa outpost remained remote and hidden.<ref name="db" />

==History==
===Old Republic era===
Around [[519 BBY/Legends|519 BBY]],<ref name="SWCL" /> the [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] from [[Kallidah/Legends|Kallidah]], another world in [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]], abandoned their homeworld and settled on Polis Massa.<ref name="Strongholds" /> They sought to prove the Eellayin were the ancestors of the Kallidahin through cloning tissue samples recovered in their digs. The most important find was the lost city of [[Wiyentaah/Legends|Wiyentaah]] (not far from the Research Base), discovered [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]], which instigated an archaeological mining project on this asteroid, to uncover the mysteries of the cataclysm and the native species it destroyed.<ref name="SWCL" /> This project lasted long enough that the Kallidahin became known as Polis Massans themselves.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Excavations on the largest Polis Massa asteroids uncovered many prize artifacts, mostly from deep within the planetoid. The Polis Massans analyzed these artifacts for organic tissue suitable for [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] lost species.<ref name="SWCL" />

[[File:PolisMassa.png|thumb|left|300px|Polis Massa asteroid field]]
Far from the more populated areas of the galaxy, the remote settlement served as an emergency sanctuary for the Jedi fugitives [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] after [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], during the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="db" /> The colony also housed the medical facilities in which [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] gave birth to the twins [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and subsequently [[Death/Legends|died]]. It was here that [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] chose to adopt Leia into his family. When Yoda arrived with Bail, he was visited by the specter of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who offered to tutor Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda in the art of surviving one's death with the consciousness still intact. Shortly after [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|Padmé's funeral]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Yoda returned to Polis Massa to retrieve a Kallidahin [[E3-standard starship lifeboat/Legends|escape pod]], to make his exile to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

Not long after the formation of the Galactic Empire, the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]] [[Malorum]] and [[Sancor]] began investigations of Polis Massa, discovering much information to be sent to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Lord Vader]]. In a fateful run-in with Obi-Wan Kenobi at the Research Base, Sancor lost his life.<ref name="DW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]''</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|By the time of the raid on Polis Massa, the men of the 501st were starting to get a little sick of this so-called "Rebellion". In the past we secretly enjoyed putting down a local insurrection or two, they kept the troops sharp and the Empire feared, But these Rebels were different. They were organized, they were growing and they were everywhere.|Diary of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]|<ref name="BF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
During the first days of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], a movement that started in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the Rebels established a secret [[Polis Massa Base (Rebel Alliance)|base]] on Polis Massa.<ref name="NEGAS" /> The base was made of isolated outposts scattered on the asteroid and connected by hidden underground tunnels. The Polis Massans were sympathetic to the Rebels and allowed them to use the Polis Massa Research Base in the Wiyentaah crater.<ref name="Strongholds" /> The Alliance launched many operations from their Polis Massan base, although the Rebel Alliance did their best not to disturb the nearby Kallidahin excavations. The base was repeatedly raided by the Empire but survived these attacks.<ref name="NEGAS" />

[[File:BF_Polis_Massa_7.jpg|thumb|right|250px|501st stormtroopers attack Rebel forces during the [[raid on Polis Massa]].]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a Polis Massan [[Polis Massa decoy outpost|Rebel outpost]] received an important transmission from other Rebels: [[Death Star plans/Legends|the plans]] of the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|new armored battle station]]. Knowing that the transmission had been made, Darth Vader ordered his agents of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to recover the plans and [[Raid on Polis Massa|destroy the Rebel outpost]]. The Bothan spies, knowing that the Empire would have tracked the transmission, secretly forwarded the plans to another Rebel outpost, the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] starship, and prepared a forgery to trick the Imperial forces as much as they could. The Empire discovered the deception during the attack but was slow in issuing new orders to the 501st. Eventually, the 501st obliterated the Rebel presence on Polis Massa and found a new trail to follow, tracking [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia Organa's [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] orbiting [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="BF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the DVD commentary for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], [[John Knoll]] explains that [[George Lucas]] designed the look of Polis Massa to be an homage to the look of the Clavius moon base in the 1968 film [[Wikipedia:2001: A Space Odyssey (film)|''2001: A Space Odyssey'']].

The asteroid colony was first known as Polis Matza during script development of ''Revenge of the Sith''. Slowed-down footage of the asteroid field from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] was used as a placeholder in the evolving edit of Episode III.<ref name="db" />

''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' uses a texture of [[Wikipedia:Jupiter|Jupiter]]'s moon [[Wikipedia:Ganymede (moon)|Ganymede]] as a texture for the planetoid.
